education: Blue Nile Film and Television Academy
bio_paragraph_1: Yared is an Addis Ababa-based cinematographer and a graduate of the Blue Nile Film and Television Academy. His work spans commercials, short films and fictional documentaries, generally defined by a naturalistic approach — motivated lighting and authentic composition in service of visuals that stay true to the story rather than calling attention to themselves.
bio_paragraph_2: He has extensive experience collaborating with international crews across a range of professional sets, moving between narrative and commercial work while keeping the same restraint and attention to light in both.
name: Yared Gebretsadkan
